instruction: Change the GNOME Shell theme to Arc by downloading it from gnome-look.org and applying it to your desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading and installing Arc theme from gnome-look.org and activating it. Evaluator uses gsettings to verify GNOME Shell theme (org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name) is set to 'Arc'. Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks GNOME Shell theme using 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name' which matches the instruction requirement exactly
The instruction asks to 'Change the GNOME Shell theme to Arc' and the evaluator verifies org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name setting, which is the correct gsettings key for GNOME Shell themes
The regex pattern ^'Arc'$ correctly matches gsettings output format (strings are quoted) and prevents false positives like 'Arc-Dark' or 'Arc-Darker'
The postconfig approach is appropriate - executes gsettings command and saves output to cache file for verification
The check_list metric with cache_file getter is semantically correct for matching regex patterns against command output
Complete coverage: Instruction requires Arc theme to be applied, evaluator verifies Arc theme is active - all requirements verified
